assessments.reasoning: The publisher-controlled English page returned the edition heading, explicit version line, and matching operative title. Those observations directly establish the claimed publisher identification. [Canonical English legal code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.en)

challenge.method: I inspected the publisher's heading, version line, canonical URL, and operative opening, then compared the deed, the Attribution-NonCommercial instrument, and the publisher's definition of canonical legal code.
challenge.results: The deed identifies the same edition and describes itself as a summary. Attribution-NonCommercial has its own title and canonical path, and its grant restricts use to NonCommercial purposes. Sharing the version number does not merge the instruments. No material contradiction was found. [Deed](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en) [Attribution-NonCommercial legal code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/legalcode.en) [Legal Code Defined](https://creativecommons.org/legal-code-defined/)

limitations: Active is the proposed index lifecycle state. The publisher heading establishes the instrument's identity and version.
The finding establishes neither an SPDX crosswalk nor equivalence to another representation.
Integrity concerns the controlled rendered response. No raw HTML digest was asserted or verified.
reasoning: Creative Commons identifies the instrument on its canonical English legal-code page as Attribution 4.0 International, labels it CC BY 4.0, and explicitly displays version 4.0.
